name: Alamere Falls
where: Palomarin Trailhead, end of Mesa Road, Bolinas · Point Reyes National Seashore
blurb: The Coast Trail from Palomarin along ocean bluffs and past Bass and Pelican lakes to Wildcat Camp, then a low-tide beach walk to a 40-ft waterfall that drops onto the sand.
status: Open; no permit for day hikes. The Palomarin lot (about 75 spaces, last 1.2 mi of Mesa Road unpaved) fills early on weekends, and the 1.1-mile beach walk from Wildcat Camp to the falls is passable only at low tide.
